verdict: The clearest isolate-one-control reference: each step shows a single enlarged UI element (pill, menu row, dialog, Play button) on a white field with an oversized hand cursor (sheet_1-5).
Typed headline with blinking caret and blue keyword introduces every step; the keyword itself zooms into the UI it names.
Pastel white-blue palette with Google brand accents; UI always sits on white or a light gradient, full editor appears only for a few 30-frame flashes.
Pacing mixes 90-400-frame explanatory holds with a rapid six-beat run of 30-frame cuts; total 21 shots in 87 s.

Useful lessons for 30 s demos: prompt-pill hero card, chips flying into the prompt, generated text streaming at large size, blue outline ring on the clicked button; the typed-caret device is cheap to reproduce in HTML overlays.
